paraphrase: Four analyst access controls for whether deliberately killing an innocent person in a specified case is prohibited: unrestricted Boolean norm assignments have no exact outward-data criterion; equating prohibition with a supplied basis assessment still leaves outward reports insufficient but admits exact enriched-data classification; an explicit categorical-prohibition restriction admits even a constant exact classifier and an erroneous report; a one-way sufficient-basis restriction supports positive certification but no exact enriched-data classifier on its residual fiber. These restricted classes are not complete moral theories or assertions of metaphysically possible worlds; no actual norm, knowledge, permission or categorical reason is established.
